_comment: Template for the ONE-OFF migrations task. The <AWS_ACCOUNT_ID>, <AWS_REGION>, and IMAGE_TAG_PLACEHOLDER tokens are substituted via `sed` by the deploy workflow before `aws ecs register-task-definition --cli-input-json file://this-file.json`. Re-register on every Prisma migration commit so the image tag tracks the latest. NOT a service — invoked via `aws ecs run-task` from the deploy pipeline (see .github/workflows/deploy.yml). Logs land in their own CloudWatch group so a failed migration is easy to spot independently of the app. Role names match the IAM roles created 2026-04-28 (region-agnostic resource ARNs): jadwal-ecs-task-execution and jadwal-ecs-task-role.
